rows: What is the dispersion relation for surface waves?
ω² = gk tanh(kh); reduces to ω²=gk (deep) or ω²=gk²h (shallow)
Why do longer waves travel faster?
Deep-water: c_p = √(g/k) — larger λ → smaller k → faster
Why do tsunamis travel at jet speed?
They're shallow-water waves: c=√(gh), h~4000 m → c~200 m/s
Speed of wave energy propagation; c_g = c_p/2 for deep water
Node of zero tidal amplitude; tidal wave rotates around it
Why do tides rotate in the North Atlantic?
Coriolis effect on basin-scale Kelvin waves
Wave guided by a coastline or equator, decays away from boundary
Westerly wind burst → equatorial Kelvin wave → thermocline displacement
Inverse barometer + wind stress piling water against shallow coasts
